author: Ari Koslow
title: Ketel Marte goes deep Saturday
desc: Ketel Marte went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Diamondbacks 4-2 loss on Saturday against the Rays.
impact: Marte cut the deficit to 4-2 with a solo blast in the eighth inning. He is up to 14 home runs on the season, while hitting .261 at the plate.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Cabrera takes loss Saturday
desc: Jose Cabrera allowed four runs on seven hits over five innings with four strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Saturday against the Rays.
impact: Cabrera allowed a solo home run to Junior Caminero in the first inning and two-run blast in the fifth to Jonathan Aranda for most of the damage. He'll make his next start against the Brewers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Lowe drives in four runs Saturday
desc: Brandon Lowe went 1-for-4 with a home run and four RBI in the Pirates 9-7 loss against the Reds on Saturday.
impact: Lowe put the Pirates on the board with a three-run blast off Chase Burns in the second inning. He later added a sacrifice fly. He is up to 20 home runs on the season, while slashing .246/.320/.515 at the plate.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gregory Soto blows save Saturday
desc: Gregory Soto allowed three runs in a blown save and loss on Saturday against the Reds.
impact: Soto entered the game to protect a 7-6 lead. He almost got himself out of trouble with a double play before a second walk in the frame was followed by a three-run home run hit by Eugenio Suárez. His recent struggles continue.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Jones struggles in loss Saturday
desc: Jared Jones allowed four runs (three earned) on four hits over 4 2/3 innings with four strikeouts and one walk in a no-decision on Saturday against the Reds.
impact: Jones allowed a run in the first, third and fifth innings. He has continued to struggle going deep in recent outings. He'll carry an ugly 5.76 ERA into his next start against the Phillies.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Sheets goes deep Saturday
desc: Gavin Sheets went 3-for-4 with a home run in the Padres 15-3 loss against the Dodgers on Saturday.
impact: Sheets went deep off Yoshinobu Yamamoto. It was his 13th long ball of the season, the lone bright spot in an otherwise ugly loss for San Diego.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Vasquez takes loss Saturday
desc: Randy Vasquez allowed seven runs (five earned) on eight hits over 5 1/3 innings with one strikeout and one walk in a loss on Saturday against the Dodgers.
impact: Vasquez pitched behind Kyle Hart as an opener. He started out well before the entire night took a turn when the Dodgers plated nine runs in the sixth inning. He is scheduled to face the Dodgers again next time on the mound.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Arozarena hits home run Saturday
desc: Randy Arozarena went 2-for-4 with a home run and three RBI in the Mariners 4-3 loss against the Guardians on Saturday.
impact: Arozarena gave Seattle some life with a three-run home run in the eighth inning. It was his first time going deep since being activated from the injured list earlier in the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Gilbert works seven innings in loss Saturday
desc: Logan Gilbert allowed four runs on seven hits over seven innings with seven strikeouts in a loss on Saturday against the Guardians.
impact: Gilbert was originally expected to be pitching in a piggyback role, but Seattle wound up giving him a normal start. He ran into trouble in the third inning when he allowed three runs. He'll carry a 3.42 ERA into his next start against the Blue Jays.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Rolison to start Sunday
desc: Ryan Rolison will start for the Cubs on Sunday against the Brewers.
impact: Rolison will figure to open for the Cubs. It is unclear who will follow him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daniel Palencia (elbow) to be sidelined through All-Star break
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Daniel Palencia will not be re-evaluated till after the All-Star break.
impact: Palencia is progressing from his elbow tendinitis. He has been on the injured list for the past couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) without timetable to return
desc: Will Smith does not hold a timetable to return.
impact: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Smith could return before the All-Star break, but the more time he misses, the longer it will take for him to ramp up. There should be a potential update on him later into July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hayden Juenger traded to Athletics
desc: The Blue Jays acquired catcher Owen Carapellotti from the Athletics for RHP Hayden Juenger.
impact: Juenger was recently designated for assignment. He'll join the Athletics organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hoby Milner (appendicitis) to miss 4-to-6 weeks
desc: Hoby Milner underwent emergency appendectomy surgery and will miss the next 4-to-6 weeks.
impact: Milner was placed on the injured list on Saturday. He could be sidelined into August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wei-En Lin to undergo Tommy John surgery
desc: Athletics prospect Wei-En Lin is set to undergo Tommy John surgery.
impact: Lin is the Athletics No. 4 prospect. He will miss the rest of this season and likely a portion of next year.
